subject: Marketplace Partner Programs & Listing Fee Renewal — action items
messages:
From: Diane Park <diane.park@aws-partners.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing fee renewal and program updates

Hi Marissa,

Hope you're doing well — quick note from the AWS marketplace team. Your current listing fee and partner program benefits are up for renewal on 2026-04-30. We've attached a renewal proposal that outlines the fee structure, referral credits, and a new program tier (Premier ISV) that you may qualify for given your recent Dedicated product launch.

Highlights: 
- Listing fee baseline remains 7% but we can offer a 1.5% credit for the next 12 months tied to Marketplace promotions (see page 2).
- Premier ISV requires a short security checklist (SOC2 evidence) and a sales enablement Q&A.
- Deadline to lock terms for Q2 promotions: 2026-03-31.

Can you confirm who on your side will own the redlines/PO process? I can loop in procurement if helpful.

Attachments: AWS_Marketplace_Renewal_Proposal.pdf (proposal, 6 pages)

Thanks,
Diane Park
Partner Development Manager — AWS Marketplace
Diane.Park@aws-partners.com

--

Note: forwarded to internal team for next steps.

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: AWS Marketplace listing fee renewal and program updates

Team — forwarding Diane's note. Quick asks: 
1) Ben — can you confirm finance runway and whether a short-term promotional credit (1.5%) is worth locking given our Q2 go-to-market?
2) Laura — can legal take a look at any material changes if we pursue Premier ISV (we'll need to provide SOC2 artifacts)?
3) Marcus — Product/Platform: any blockers for meeting the sales enablement request (demo recording & 1-pager) in two weeks?

I attached the proposal Diane sent. We also heard from GCP and Azure about similar program updates (see separate attachments).

Proposed timeline: internal review by 2026-03-20, reply to partners and lock any promotional terms by 2026-03-31.

Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments referenced: AWS_Marketplace_Renewal_Proposal.pdf, Azure_Partner_Program_Terms.docx, GCP_pricing_matrix.xlsx

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: AWS Marketplace listing fee renewal and program updates

Marissa — quick finance take:
- The incremental 1.5% credit for 12 months would net us ~12-15k in savings this fiscal year based on current marketplace revenue. It tilts in favor if we plan a promotional push in Q2.
- If we commit to Premier ISV level there may be an onboarding fee (~$5k) and expected co-marketing spend. Need exact numbers from Diane.
- Procurement/PO side: Procurement can process a renewal PO once legal signs off on terms. Suggested owner: me (Ben) to coordinate with AP.

I'll review the attachments and come back with a short P&L by 2026-03-19.

Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: AWS Marketplace listing fee renewal and program updates

Team — legal review notes (high level):
- The renewal proposal contains a couple of new clauses around data usage for marketing attribution and a tighter indemnity scope for marketplace-provided analytics. We should request redlines to limit data retention to contractually agreed marketing metrics only.
- For Premier ISV, SOC2 evidence should be provided as a statement of compliance; do not include raw logs or backups. We can provide an SOC2 attestation letter and a scoped evidence bundle if needed.
- I'll prepare a redline and a short cover memo explaining the requested changes. ETA: draft redline by 2026-03-19 EOD.

If we want to push for the promotional credit, we should get the commercial terms locked before 2026-03-31.

Laura Bennett
General Counsel (interim)
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Attachment stub: redline_skeleton_aws.docx

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Hi Diane / Victor / Lena — thanks for the proposals and follow ups. Summary from Redwood: 
1) We're interested in the AWS promotional credit and evaluating Premier ISV; Ben will own the procurement/PO and Laura will provide legal redlines (expected 2026-03-19, completed).
2) For GCP and Azure, we want equivalent promotional language and clarity on partner co-marketing commitments; Victor/Lena, can you confirm parity or provide written terms we can compare?
3) Next steps: Laura will send redlines to Diane; Ben will issue a preliminary P&L and proposed PO amount; Marcus will deliver the requested demo recording and 1-pager by 2026-03-27.

Please send the finalized partner program bullet points and any DocuSign or PO instructions. We aim to finalize terms and lock promotional credits by 2026-03-31.
